paper.title: Robust edge multiscale space based hybrid Schwarz preconditioner for high-frequency Helmholtz problems
paper.abstract: We develop a novel hybrid Schwarz method, termed the robust edge multiscale space based hybrid Schwarz method (REMs-HS), for the efficient solution of high-frequency Helmholtz problems. The method combines a one-level restricted additive Schwarz preconditioner with impedance transmission conditions
